Class Answer

java.lang.Object
application.Answer
public class Answer extends Object
Creates the Answer class that contains all necessary data types for Answer Objects to function. Contains setters and getters for necessary variables.

      public Answer(int id, String userName, String answerText, int questionLinkID, Boolean hideUserName, int answerLinkID, int level, String highestRole)

      Parameters:
      id - Id number as an int.
      userName - String containing the userName.
      answerText - String containing the answer text.
      questionLinkID - Int containing the questionLinkID.
      hideUserName - Boolean for whether it should be anonymous.
      answerLinkID - Int containing the answerLinkID.
      level - Int containing the level for
      highestRole - String containing the highestRole of user creating Answer.
